lines.t: Obedience cuts deeper than trust
The shadow moves where the fire has grown
We walk in light, not just in touch
Chasing truth through flesh and bone
Hearts unshamed, no fear to keep
Peace awake where lies decay
The faithful rise, the humble breathe
In mercy's arms we find our way
Cause obedience alone
Burns cold in the dark
And trust alone can't carry the spark
But when they meet, they beat as one
The bloom of a light where grace begun
Oh, in trusting silence it's a scream
A breath of love through the machine
Lay every doubt before its flame
Truth still whispers your name
Step by step through open skies
Not chains but choice and sacrifice
We walk by love, not what we see
Grace alive inside of me
Cause obedience alone
Burns cold in the dark
And trust alone
Can't carry the spark
But when they meet
They beat as one
The bloom of light where grace begun
Rise up heart and live in fire
Not by demand but deep desire
Truth ain't talk, it's what we breathe
Love's the life that never leaves
Obedience alone burns cold in the dark
And trust alone fades from the spark
But bound in love, they find the truth
The root of life that carries you
We'll be right back.
We'll be right back.
